title: Spicy Miso Ramen
description: A spicy and savory twist on the classic Japanese ramen. A perfect comfort food for any occasion.
instructions: Bring the spicy miso broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the ramen noodles and cook according to package instructions.
While the noodles are cooking, heat the miso paste in a small saucepan over low heat.
Add the bryndza cheese to the miso paste and stir until melted.
Season the miso-bryndza mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
To assemble the ramen, place a portion of noodles in a bowl and top with the miso-bryndza mixture.
Add sliced green onions, bean sprouts, and scallions on top of the miso-bryndza mixture.
If desired, sprinkle shredded oozy cheese on top for an extra burst of flavor.
